title: English Language Teachers' Guide, Grade 06 (To be implemented from 2015)
edition: First Edition 2014, NIE Department of English (listed on nie.lk as 'English (2015)')
notes: 68 PDF pages. Contains the full Grade 6 syllabus (8 competencies, 47 competency levels, subject content, learning outcomes, periods) on pp. xiii-xl, then per-competency guidance on pp. 1-26 (periods, outcomes, lesson-plan and assessment notes, further reading). No separate Grade 6 English syllabus is listed on nie.lk/selesyll; the syllabus lives inside this guide. Found via nie.lk/seletguide -> Grade 6. First curl attempts got HTTP 503 (Cloudflare/rate limit); a later retry succeeded.
